columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: AI approval judgments need separate, versioned authority before they can become effective sign-off
columns.title_zh: AI 的 Approval Judgment 在成为有效 Sign-off 前，需要独立且版本化的 Authority
columns.source_zh: GitHub Copilot 的 PR Approval Authority 公告，并由 OpenAI Codex Guardian Root Authorization Evidence 的 Maintainer 实现交叉支持
columns.reason: Selected as a cross-sample Agent Governance problem anchored in SIG-20260905-002 and independently strengthened by implementation evidence in SIG-20260905-003. GitHub separates an AI reviewer's approval assessment from the authority to create a pull-request approval that participates in merge governance: the assessment is available, while actual sign-off is disabled by default and requires explicit administrative authorization. Codex independently versions the root authorization evidence behind Guardian review, invalidates a cached allow when that evidence changes, and strips parent-only approvals on worker fork. Together they support a bounded question that remains meaningful without either vendor: what distinct authority evidence must turn an AI-generated approval judgment into an effective organizational sign-off, and when must that authority expire or be invalidated as principal, instruction, evidence or execution context changes? This is materially different from the recent delegation-chain and connector-layer questions because it focuses on the transition from judgment to authority-bearing approval and on the lifetime of that approval evidence.
columns.reason_zh: 作为跨样本 Agent Governance 问题选入，以 SIG-20260905-002 为锚点，并由 SIG-20260905-003 的实现级证据独立增强。GitHub 将 AI Reviewer 的 Approval Assessment 与真正参与 Merge Governance 的 Pull-request Approval Authority 分开：Assessment 可以生成，但实际 Sign-off 默认关闭，必须由管理员显式授权。Codex 则独立地对 Guardian Review 背后的 Root Authorization Evidence 做版本化；当证据发生变化时，Cached Allow 自动失效，并在 Worker Fork 时剥离 Parent-only Approval。两个样本共同支持一个去掉厂商名称仍成立的有界问题：AI 生成的 Approval Judgment 要变成真正具有组织效力的 Sign-off，需要哪些独立 Authority Evidence；当 Principal、Instruction、Evidence 或 Execution Context 改变时，这份 Authority 又应在何时过期或失效？该问题不同于近期的 Delegation Principal Chain 与 Connector Layered Authority，重点是从 Judgment 到 Authority-bearing Approval 的转换，以及 Approval Evidence 的有效期。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify GitHub's exact assessment-versus-sign-off policy boundary and administrator scopes, then inspect Codex's root-authorization evidence versioning, cached-allow invalidation, compaction preservation and worker-fork stripping. It must distinguish recommendation, review result, authorization evidence and effective approval, and state what neither sample proves about end-to-end organizational accountability or human principal identity.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 GitHub 中 Assessment 与 Sign-off 的精确 Policy Boundary 及 Administrator Scope，并检查 Codex 的 Root-authorization Evidence Versioning、Cached-allow Invalidation、Compaction Preservation 与 Worker-fork Stripping。必须区分 Recommendation、Review Result、Authorization Evidence 与 Effective Approval，并明确两个样本都不能证明哪些端到端组织问责或 Human Principal Identity 结论。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: No Selection. SIG-20260905-001 exposes a useful architecture mechanism for managed browser/native-app policy, destination exceptions and approval lifetimes, but today's evidence is still a single official vendor announcement and does not satisfy Skill 02's evidence-sufficiency gate as an independent Research Object. SIG-20260905-006 provides stronger implementation evidence for binding MCP redirects to the original trust origin, but its underlying research problem substantially overlaps the 2026-09-03 selected object on preserving authorization-server identity through issuer binding across discovery and redirects. Elevating it today would repeat the same trust-substitution problem rather than add a material new research delta. The HPC research artifact has secondary architectural implications but is selected once in Open-source Engineering to avoid semantic duplication.
columns.reason_zh: No Selection。SIG-20260905-001 提供了有价值的架构机制：受管 Browser/Native App Policy、Destination Exception 与 Approval Lifetime，但今天仍只有一份官方厂商公告，作为独立 Research Object 不满足 Skill 02 的 Evidence Sufficiency Gate。SIG-20260905-006 对 MCP Redirect 必须绑定原始 Trust Origin 提供了更强的实现证据，但其底层研究问题与 2026-09-03 已选中的“通过 Issuer Binding 在 Discovery 与 Redirect 过程中保持 Authorization-server Identity”高度重叠；今天再次提升会重复同一个 Trust-substitution Problem，而不是形成实质新 Research Delta。HPC 研究 Artifact 虽具有次级架构影响，但已在开源工程栏目只选一次，以避免语义重复。
columns.next: Retain SIG-20260905-001 as a candidate for a later cross-sample comparison of policy defaults, exceptions and approval TTL. Treat SIG-20260905-006 as duplicate evidence for the existing redirect/identity research line rather than a new Daily object. Reading must perform no separate Industry Architecture Deep Reading for this run.
columns.next_zh: 保留 SIG-20260905-001 为 Candidate，等待后续围绕 Policy Default、Exception 与 Approval TTL 的跨样本比较；将 SIG-20260905-006 视为既有 Redirect/Identity 研究线的重复证据，而不是新的 Daily Object。本轮 Reading 不得单独执行行业架构栏目的 Deep Reading。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Agentic code-generation evaluation must test iterative tool use and scaling, not only one-shot correctness
columns.title_zh: Agentic Code Generation 的评估必须测试迭代 Tool Use 与 Scaling，而不能只看 One-shot Correctness
columns.source_zh: Zenodo 22299039 一手可复现研究 Artifact：Supercomputer 环境中的 Agentic Julia Code Generation
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260905-007 after Skill 02 triage. The primary reproducible artifact evaluates an autonomous plan-generate-refine loop for Julia code in a supercomputing environment, moving the research target from one-shot code-generation accuracy to tool-mediated iteration plus parallel and scalability constraints. The bounded engineering question is which evaluation evidence is required before agent-generated software can be called operationally capable: generated-code correctness alone, or also the agent's iterative tool-use behavior, parallel execution and scaling characteristics? This is a question-first primary research finding with reproducible evidence, does not depend on a vendor release, adds a materially different evaluation topic from the recent recovery/authorization objects, and satisfies Skill 02's requirement that research and benchmark evidence compete on value rather than recency.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260905-007。该一手可复现 Artifact 在 Supercomputer 环境中评估 Julia Code 的自主 Plan–Generate–Refine Loop，把研究对象从 One-shot Code-generation Accuracy 扩展到 Tool-mediated Iteration，以及 Parallel/Scalability Constraint。边界清晰的工程问题是：在把 Agent 生成的软件称为具有 Operational Capability 之前，需要哪些评估证据——只有生成代码的正确性，还是还必须观察 Agent 的迭代 Tool Use、并行执行与 Scaling 特征？该对象由问题和可复现的一手研究 Finding 驱动，不依赖 Vendor Release，与近期 Recovery/Authorization 对象形成实质不同的评估主题，也满足 Skill 02 要求 Research/Benchmark Evidence 按研究价值而非更新速度参与竞争。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the artifact contents, autonomous planning/generation/refinement loop, Julia documentation/tool integration, supercomputing environment, benchmark tasks, correctness and scaling metrics, baselines and failure cases, reproducibility instructions, and limits on generalizing from Julia/HPC workloads to ordinary software-engineering agents.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Artifact 内容、自主 Planning/Generation/Refinement Loop、Julia Documentation/Tool Integration、Supercomputing Environment、Benchmark Task、Correctness 与 Scaling Metric、Baseline 与 Failure Case、复现说明，以及从 Julia/HPC Workload 推广到普通 Software-engineering Agent 时的边界。
